title: Proper projection realizes the fixed direct-image projection
statement: For a positive finite coefficient operation datum S, proper f:X→Y, arbitrary bounded constructible K on X and finite-Tor bounded constructible L on Y, use the coordinates of [def-sf-finite-projection-fixed-coordinates]. The image J_Y(properComponent S f K L), followed by directCoordinates at T_X(K,U_f^tor L) and Q_f(targetCoordinates at K,L), equals directTensorCoordinates at K,L followed by the published fixed-scalar rightDerivedLowerStarProjectionMap at J_X K,R_Y^{-1}L. This is an equality of projection maps before applying any pullback or supplied adjunction transpose; no finite Tor bound on K and no projection invertibility is assumed.

source.place: Proper-factor paragraph: the direct-image projection is the transpose of counit tensor identity, read through pullback monoidality; finite coefficient normalization

proof.text: Expand properComponent as the inverse proper identification, the compactification component at the identity-open compactification, and the proper identification on the target. Apply the inverse coefficient equivalence after the full constructible inclusion. Substitute finiteProperNormalization at both objects. The support realization comparisons cancel, leaving the fixed compactification projection and its coefficient-unit cancellations.

For the identity-open compactification, the inverse open projection followed by the pullback composition cancels the identity-open unit. The remaining projection is the published fixed direct-image projection, by its proper-counit definition. Move the fixed direct-image comparison past the coefficient counit by naturality and cancel the two equivalence units by the triangle identities. Its remaining source and target isomorphisms are exactly directTensorCoordinates and directCoordinates followed by Q_f(targetCoordinates). These calculations need no invertibility of the projection and no Tor bound on the first input.

mathlib_searches.query: Transporting a right adjoint counit through an equivalence and a full subcategory preserves its specified coefficient normalization
mathlib_searches.results: Adjunction.map_restrictFullyFaithful_counit_app and Equivalence.counit_naturality_assoc give generic component formulas. Neither states the compatibility of the specified intrinsic derived coefficient comparisons and fixed coefficient projection.
mathlib_searches.verdict: Use the generic naturality and adjunction identities; no specialized normalization found.

mathlib_searches.query: The projection map of a right adjoint has transpose equal to tensor pullback comparison followed by counit tensor identity
mathlib_searches.results: Eight generic monoidal and Cartesian adjunction results, including CategoryTheory.frobeniusMorphism. None identifies the prescribed constructible/fixed coefficient comparisons. Loogle search for CategoryTheory.Adjunction.map_rightAdjointProjectionMap_app_app_comp_counit found no Mathlib identifier; the adopted source library supplies it.

mathlib_searches.query: rightAdjointProjectionMap; unitInv_naturality; sfIntrinsicDerivedDirectImageComparison; fixedPullRealization in Mathlib/CategoryTheory and the two library roots
mathlib_searches.results: Mathlib Equivalence provides unitInv_naturality and triangle identities. Source Adjunction/ProjectionMap and ProEtale/FiniteCoefficient/Derived/LowerStarProjection provide the fixed scalar projection and its counit transpose. ConstructibleProjectionMates and SfIntrinsicRealizationTransport provide the actual coefficient comparisons, but not these two normalization equations.
mathlib_searches.verdict: Reuse the existing constructions; only their two normalization equations remain new.

theorem properComponent_fixed_realization (S : SixFunctorFiniteOperations D C E n hn)
    {X Y : SixFunctorSpace D} (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsProper f.hom.left]
    (K : sixFunctorFiniteCategory D C E n hn X)
    (L : finiteTorConstructibleCategory C.l E n hn Y.obj.left) :
    letI := Padic.finite_coefficientExtensionRing C.l E n hn
    (coordinates (C := C) (E := E) (n := n) (hn := hn) Y).map
        (properComponent S f K L) ≫
      (directCoordinates S f (((partialTensor S X).obj K).obj ((torPull S f).obj L))).hom ≫
      (fixedDirect (C := C) (E := E) (n := n) f).map (targetCoordinates S f K L).hom =
    (directTensorCoordinates S f K L).hom ≫
      ((AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.rightDerivedLowerStarProjectionMap
        (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing C.l E n)))
          f.hom.left).app
            ((coordinates (C := C) (E := E) (n := n) (hn := hn) X).obj K)).app
              ((realization (C := C) (E := E) (n := n) (hn := hn) Y).inverse.obj L.obj)
